rows.title: Screen saver ads
rows.desc: Adverts that some apps, such as LG Channels, show in the screen saver. LG calls this Screen Saver Promotion.

rows.title: Sponsored tiles on Home
rows.desc: Adverts marked Sponsored on the Home screen. LG calls this Home Promotion.

rows.title: Recommendations on Home
rows.desc: Rows of recommended programmes and films on the Home screen. LG calls this Content Recommendation.

rows.title: Ads while watching
rows.desc: Adverts and offers shown over what is on screen, while LG's Live Plus is on. LG calls this Live Promotion.

rows.title: Smart tips
rows.desc: Suggestions for TV features that pop up while watching or using an app. LG calls this Smart Tips.

rows.title: Smart tips in Settings
rows.desc: Suggested settings shown in LG's Settings menu. LG calls this Smart Tips in Settings.

rows.title: Game genre
rows.desc: Tunes the picture for the kind of game. Each genre keeps its own stabilizer settings.

rows.title: Prevent input delay
rows.desc: Standard cuts input lag for the kind of content; Boost cuts it further by matching the console's frame rate.

rows.title: VRR & G-Sync
rows.desc: Lets the TV follow the frame rate a console or PC sends, so motion stays smooth without tearing.

rows.title: AMD FreeSync Premium
rows.desc: The same for AMD graphics cards and consoles that use FreeSync.

rows.title: ALLM
rows.desc: Switches the TV to its low-latency game mode by itself when a connected device starts a game.

rows.title: Dark room mode
rows.desc: Lowers the brightness for playing in a dark room.

rows.title: Black stabilizer
rows.desc: Lifts dark areas so detail in shadows is easier to see.

rows.title: White stabilizer
rows.desc: Tames bright areas so detail in highlights is easier to see.

rows.title: AI Game Sound
rows.desc: Sets the sound for the game being played: effects, clear voices and surround.

rows.title: Sound output
rows.desc: Where the TV plays its sound. Sound mode and balance apply only to the TV speakers.

rows.title: Sound mode
rows.desc: How the TV tunes its sound, through its own speakers only. AI Sound Pro adjusts it to what is on by itself.

rows.title: Digital sound output
rows.desc: The audio sent to a soundbar or receiver over HDMI ARC or optical. Pass Through sends Dolby and DTS as they are; PCM turns them into plain stereo.

rows.title: Balance
rows.desc: Between the left and right TV speakers, and only those. At 0 both play at the same level.

rows.title: Automatic volume
rows.desc: Keeps the volume level when switching channels. LG calls this Automatic Volume Adjustment.

rows.title: Bluetooth speaker mode
rows.desc: Lets phones in Bluetooth range connect and play music through the TV, even while it is switched off. LG calls this Bluetooth Speaker Mode.

rows.title: eARC
rows.desc: Sends lossless and Dolby Atmos audio to a soundbar or receiver on the HDMI (eARC) input, where both support it.

rows.title: SIMPLINK (HDMI-CEC)
rows.desc: Lets the TV remote control devices connected over HDMI, such as a soundbar or console.

rows.title: Auto power sync
rows.desc: Switching the TV off switches connected devices off, and switching a device on switches the TV on.

rows.title: IP control
rows.desc: Lets home automation systems control the TV over the network with LG's own protocol. Off unless something needs it.
